description:
Protect what you share. MaskID helps you prepare safer copies of documents, photos, IDs and PDFs before sending them to another person, company or service.

A landlord may need proof of identity, but not every number on your ID. A recruiter may need a certificate, but not your home address or signature. A bank, insurer, hotel or online service may request a document, but that does not mean every detail has to remain exposed.

MaskID gives you control before you tap Share.

HIDE SENSITIVE INFORMATION
Cover any detail the recipient does not need. Draw and adjust masks manually, or use on-device OCR suggestions to help locate identity numbers, email addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and payment-card numbers. You decide what stays visible and what does not.

ADD PURPOSE-SPECIFIC WATERMARKS
Mark the copy with its intended use before sending it. Add a custom watermark such as “For rental verification only”, a recipient name, a purpose or other context that makes the shared copy easier to identify and harder to reuse outside its intended purpose.

CREATE A SAFER COPY
MaskID keeps your original separate from the protected copy you export. Protected PDF pages are rasterized and the exported PDF is checked for residual selectable text in masked regions, helping prevent hidden text from remaining underneath visual cover-ups.

REMOVE HIDDEN PHOTO DATA
Supported image exports can remove sensitive EXIF and GPS metadata, reducing the amount of invisible information that travels with a photo.

FIND SENSITIVE DATA FASTER
On-device OCR can suggest areas that may contain:
• Identity and document numbers (passports, IDs, driver’s licenses)
• Email addresses and phone numbers
• IBANs and bank account details
• Payment-card numbers

Suggestions are there to speed up review. You always confirm what should be hidden before export.

BUILT FOR REAL-LIFE SHARING
Use MaskID before sharing documents for:
• Rental and housing applications
• Job applications and onboarding
• Travel, hotel bookings and accommodation
• Account or identity verification
• Banking and insurance
• Healthcare and administrative procedures
• Legal or professional processes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Document processing and OCR run entirely on your device. No account required. MaskID includes an encrypted local library, a device-authenticated encrypted Vault and an optional private iCloud index.

IMPORT YOUR WAY
Bring documents into MaskID from Files, Photos, the camera, the document scanner or the Share Extension. Work with individual files or process multiple documents in batches with reusable templates.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
Automatic detection assists your workflow, but you remain in charge. Review every page before sharing and confirm that all sensitive details are covered.

Protect the copy. Limit what you reveal. Add context with a watermark. Share with more control.

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
MaskID supports iPhone, iPad, keyboard navigation, VoiceOver and Dynamic Type.

whatsNew:
What's New in MaskID 1.0.4:
• Smart Redaction Presets: 1-tap redaction tailored for rental applications, employment onboarding, hotel check-ins, and banking, including automatic purpose watermarks.
• QR & Barcode Detection: Automatically detect and redact 2D codes and barcodes on identity cards and official documents.
• Hold-to-Peek Comparator: Press and hold «Original» to instantly preview unmasked documents before exporting.
• High-Performance Engine: Async thumbnail generation and granular persistence for faster loading and reduced memory usage.
